verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a public Editor API at api.playcanvas.com/editor for programmatically handling scene manipulation, asset management and custom tool integration. The user manual points to it for changing scenes from code, a runtime probe confirms it is separately documented, and the plans page lists REST API access. missing for 10: REST API documentation beyond a plan-page line item (scope and plan gating unclear), and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all OpenAPI paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Editor module provides a comprehensive API for automating and extending the functionality of the PlayCanvas Editor. It allows developers to programmatically interact with the Editor, facilitating tasks such as scene manipulation, asset management, and custom tool integration.
change scenes from code with the Editor API
A scriptable Editor API is separately documented at api.playcanvas.com/editor/.
